data.name: Explanation
data.value: Android asks for photo and video access so Cotton can preserve the location data inside them. This access is used only to back up your files. Cotton does not determine or track your current location.

data.name: DeniedWarning
data.value: Without this permission, Android can remove location data before Cotton reads the file. Uploads may then differ from your originals. Cotton keeps those originals on your device, even if automatic deletion is enabled.
